title: Tested: 2004 Honda S2000
summary: Car and Driver’s archive test describes the revised S2000 as more flexible in everyday driving while preserving its high-revving character, with chassis changes aimed at more progressive behavior.

title: 2000 Honda S2000 — First Drive & Road Test
summary: MotorTrend’s first-drive coverage presents the S2000 as a focused rear-drive roadster built around a high-revving engine and an enthusiast-oriented driving experience.

title: 1992 Speeding Beauties: Four Quick Sports Cars Compared
summary: Car and Driver’s archive comparison places the RX-7 in a group of quick sports cars, making the article useful context for its lightweight, rotary-powered character.

title: 2007 BMW Z4 M Coupe First Drive
summary: MotorTrend’s first-drive review is a period perspective on the Z4 M Coupe’s rear-drive layout, inline-six performance, and blend of compact sports-car focus with coupe practicality.

title: 1999 Porsche 911 Carrera — Long-Term Road Test
summary: Car and Driver’s 40,000-mile report emphasizes the 911’s effortless performance and durability under enthusiastic use, while also showing that major maintenance can be expensive.

title: ’99 Porsche 911 Carrera — First Drive
summary: MotorTrend’s period first drive presents the new 996-generation Carrera as roomier, quieter, and more predictable while retaining strong performance and a manual six-speed option.

title: Tested: 2018 Porsche 718 Boxster and Cayman GTS
summary: Car and Driver highlights the GTS’s 365-hp turbo flat-four and finds its test-track gains over the S models modest, with the appeal coming from the sportier overall specification.

title: 2018 Porsche 718 Cayman and Boxster GTS First Drive Review
summary: MotorTrend’s first-drive review frames the 2018 GTS models as sharp mid-engine sports cars, with the manual transmission an important part of their enthusiast appeal.

title: Tested: 2012 Nissan GT-R
summary: Car and Driver’s test focuses on the 2012 GT-R’s 530-hp power upgrade and sub-three-second acceleration, while noting the car’s continued evolution toward greater speed and smoothness.

title: 2012 Nissan GT-R Expert Review
summary: MotorTrend describes the 2012 GT-R as supercar-fast and technically sophisticated, while flagging its stiff, noisy ride, disappointing interior, and maintenance costs.
